# Shard Btmkr — Free Hip-Hop Beat Pack

> A free lead-magnet landing page from Mexican beatmaker Dario Garcia (Shard Btmkr). Visitors enter their email to receive a free hip-hop beat pack: 5 beats in WAV 44.1 kHz / 24-bit plus 25 separate stems (kick, snare, hats, bass, melody, FX), with BPM and key. The license allows personal and commercial use, including monetization on YouTube, Spotify and TikTok; reselling the beats unmodified is not allowed. New packs are released weekly.

Canonical site: https://shardbeats.github.io/landing/
Spanish version: https://shardbeats.github.io/landing/
English version: https://shardbeats.github.io/landing/en/
Last updated: 2026-11-10
Author: Dario Garcia (Shard Btmkr), La Piedad, Michoacán, Mexico
Contact: https://github.com/shardbeats

## Offer

- [Free beat pack (Spanish)](https://shardbeats.github.io/landing/#descargar) — 5 beats in WAV + 25 stems, royalty-free, no card required.
- [Free beat pack (English)](https://shardbeats.github.io/landing/en/#download) — same pack, English landing.
- [FAQ Spanish](https://shardbeats.github.io/landing/#faq) — pricing, licensing, stems and release cadence.
- [FAQ English](https://shardbeats.github.io/landing/en/#faq)
